paper.title_en: Simulation-based inference for gravitational-wave cosmology: parameter reconstruction of a first-order electroweak phase transition
paper.abstract_en: The detection of a stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) from a cosmological first- order phase transition would be unambiguous evidence for physics beyond the Standard Model, with a strong electroweak phase transition (EWPT) at LISA as a prime example. Reconstructing the underlying model from such a signal is challenging, since the map from the model parameters to the spectrum is degenerate and strong transitions occupy only small and sparse regions of parameter space. We show that simulation-based inference (SBI), a likelihood-free approach applicable to generic SGWB sources, provides a reliable parameter reconstruction despite these difficulties. We first apply SBI to the thermodynamic parameters characterizing the transition, namely its strength, inverse duration, temperature and bubble wall velocity. As a concrete application, we then consider a strong EWPT in a singlet extension of the Standard Model and reconstruct the model parameters from the resulting SGWB. We find that the SBI posteriors agree with those of a likelihood-based Markov chain Monte Carlo analysis, at negligible cost per data set once the network has been trained. Using the network posterior as the proposal for importance sampling with the exact likelihood further corrects its remaining deviations, at a sampling efficiency several orders of magnitude higher than sampling from the prior. SBI thus offers a fast and flexible framework for the cosmological science case of LISA

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文聚焦随机引力波背景（SGWB）的参数反演，属于PTA/引力波宇宙学主题；提出将无似然的模拟推断（SBI）用于从SGWB谱重建一阶电弱相变参数，并与基于似然的MCMC结果对比，方法层面具有参考价值。理论深度适中，属于方法学而非深层引力理论构造。
decision.title_zh: 面向引力波宇宙学的模拟推断：一阶电弱相变参数的重建
decision.abstract_zh: 探测来自宇宙学一阶相变的随机引力波背景（SGWB）将是超越标准模型物理的确凿证据，其中在LISA可观测的强电弱相变（EWPT）就是一个典型例子。从这种信号中重建其底层模型具有挑战性，因为从模型参数到谱的映射存在简并，而且强相变只占据参数空间中狭小且稀疏的区域。我们表明，模拟推断（SBI）——一种适用于一般SGWB源的无似然方法——尽管存在这些困难，仍能提供可靠的参数重建。我们首先将SBI应用于刻画该相变的热力学参数，即其强度、逆持续时间、温度和气泡壁速度。作为一个具体应用，我们随后考虑标准模型单态扩展中的一个强EWPT，并从由此产生的SGWB重建模型参数。我们发现，在网络训练完成后，SBI的后验与基于似然的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛分析的后验一致，且每个数据集的成本可忽略不计。将网络后验作为使用精确似然的重要性抽样的提议分布，进一步修正了其残余偏差，抽样效率比从先验分布抽样高出若干数量级。因此，SBI为LISA的宇宙学科学目标提供了一个快速而灵活的框架。
